verdict.rationale: Supabase publishes a live OpenAPI 3.0 spec for its Management API at supabase.com/openapi.json (probe confirms HTTP 200 with 'openapi' key), and this is explicitly surfaced as an agent resource in llms.txt alongside the MCP endpoint. This directly satisfies the machine-readable API spec requirement for AI-native consumption. Missing for 10: no independent/community corroboration of third parties actually consuming the OpenAPI spec programmatically, and no explicit spec for the auto-generated per-project REST/GraphQL data APIs (only the Management API is documented as OpenAPI).
